definitions.explanation: A brief period of time; used especially in expressions emphasizing urgency.

examples.japanese: {一刻|いっこく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I want to go as soon as possible.

examples.japanese: {一刻|いっこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an urgent situation where every moment counts.

examples.japanese: {一刻|いっこく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We can't waste even a moment.

notes:
{一刻|いっこく} refers to a moment or instant of time.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一刻|いっこく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧: as soon as possible, without delay
- {一刻|いっこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧: every moment counts (urgent)
- {一刻|いっこく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしない: not waste a single moment
- {一刻|いっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猶予|ゆうよ}→猶予：13496_yuuyo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no time to delay

ETYMOLOGY:
{刻|こく} was once a unit in traditional timekeeping; today {一刻|いっこく} is used only figuratively, for a very short time, and mostly in the set phrases above. It is written and formal in tone; in conversation ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧ or ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧ is more usual.
